verdict.rationale: Discord's own webhook docs say webhooks are a low-effort way to post messages to channels without a bot user or authentication. They also say webhooks can send messages into channels over HTTP, with CI/CD build notifications given as a use case. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the webhook URL/execute endpoint and payload format, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can post a message into a channel with a simple incoming webhook URL

citations.quote: Webhooks are a low-effort way to post messages to channels in Discord. They do not require a bot user or authentication to use.
Send messages into Discord channels or receive event notifications from Discord delivered to your app over HTTP.
CI/CD pipelines posting build results or deployment notifications
